main_body: Two logs lying horizontally. Their round cream end-grain faces point west and their dark bark bodies extend east.
top_band: none. At x=7 the column runs outline, then cream end-grain (rows 4-8), then dark bark (rows 9-13). At x=11 it runs outline, a 1-row mid-brown highlight, then dark brown and black bark. No lighter horizontal top surface sits above a front face.
evidence: The logs are drawn as a side profile. The circular end faces are vertical faces seen head-on, and the bark bodies are dark with only a 1-row brown highlight at the top. No horizontal surface is readable from above (no lighter top band, no step, no front edge line). This matches the red 'side elevation' failure: it is a profile silhouette with no visible top surface.

style.evidence: The cream end-grain ramp has about 4 steps (#fff0c0, #efd6a2, #dfbd84, #cfa466), plus ring dots. The bark ramp has about 4 browns (#8b6435, #502e15, #3e220f, #1a0c04). The outline is a tinted dark brown (#2c1709) and the measured neutral share is 0%. Flat-fill coverage is 0%. The median of 9 colours per tile is close to Beodeul's typical median of about 10, though total distinct colours (9) are far below the references (38-40). The bark is rather dark and lightly textured. For a small piece this is acceptable beside the references.
